title.narrative: Coordinating, advocating and learning about human mobility in CAM

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen a coordinated regional response by Church-based organisations to the growing crisis of human mobility in Central America. Migration and displacement in the region are driven by violence, political instability, poverty and climate change, leaving many people in need of protection and humanitarian assistance.
The initiative will bring together Caritas organisations, the Jesuit Migrant Network and other Church actors to improve coordination and collaboration across key countries along the migration route, particularly Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador and Mexico. The project seeks to move from isolated interventions toward a more strategic regional programme supported by multiple international partners.
Activities will focus on strengthening coordination among Church networks, improving humanitarian assistance and protection services for migrants, and generating research and evidence to support advocacy. Through these efforts, the project aims to enhance the capacity of local organisations, improve support for migrants in vulnerable situations and promote more effective and coordinated responses to migration across the region.
